children: Grain futures are little changed in cautious trading ahead of the USDA's November WASDE report, due at 12pm ET. The market is looking for the USDA to lower its corn crop estimate from October, while raising its estimate for soybeans. "With CBOT grain futures already compressed, the report will need to be bearish to sustain a deeper correction," AgResource says in a note. Corn is up 0.5%, wheat is up 0.1% and soybeans are off 0.1%.(anthony.harrup@wsj.com)
